$comment: PRC-L108: every workflow with a schedule: trigger must be listed under gates or exempt (enforced by check-scheduled-gates-registry.mjs). maxAgeHours = cron period + 24h slack (nightly 48, weekly 192): a gate is stale when it has no successful scheduled run in that window. Read by scheduled-gate-freshness.mjs (scheduled-gates-watchdog.yml).

exempt.reason: The watchdog itself: a red watchdog run is the notification, so it must not flag its own failures.
